title: Bearbeiten erzeugt eine neue Version und setzt die Freigabe zurück
description: As a security admin, I want every content change to create a new version that must be scanned again, so that an approved prompt can never carry unapproved content.

acceptance_criteria.given: version 1 of a prompt is APPROVED
acceptance_criteria.when: the author changes the content and saves
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and creates version 2 with status PENDING
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-008-prompt-edit-new-version.feature: Editing an approved prompt creates a new pending version

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt exists in organisation B
acceptance_criteria.when: a developer of organisation A submits an edit for that prompt
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 404 and no version is created
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-008-prompt-edit-new-version.feature: Editing a prompt of another organisation is not possible

acceptance_criteria.given: version 1 of a prompt is APPROVED
acceptance_criteria.when: the author saves without changing title, content, category or tags
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and returns version 1 unchanged
and: the number of versions stays at one and no scan is triggered
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-008-prompt-edit-new-version.feature: A save without content change creates no new version
